subject: Creative Arts
source: NaCCA Creative Arts Curriculum for Primary Schools (Basic 4–6), September 2019; codes and progression cross-checked against curriculum-derived Basic 6 schemes.
accessibility: Prompts may be read aloud. Learners may respond orally, in writing, by drawing, movement, or demonstration as appropriate. Use teacher-provided examples and locally available materials; assess learning, not personal identity or access to resources.
